title: Olatunji Kelvin Johnson, born on August 9, 1967, in Lagos, is the Director of Nigeria Cleaning Service Limited, the largest cleaning company in Nigeria, founded by his parents. He received his education in Lagos and Cameroon, earning a Bachelor of Arts degree in French and Portuguese from the University of Ife. Olatunji began working in the family business at a young age and progressed through various roles, ultimately becoming the Director of Operations in 2003. He holds several professional certifications and is an active member of various organizations. Olatunji is married with three children and is involved in social clubs.
